svg.title: One-to-One Consent Architecture for Lead Buyers
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-one-to-one-consent-architecture; chapter number: 11; title: One-to-One Consent Architecture for Lead Buyers; subtitle: Who holds the record, what gets captured, and how revocations are honored; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Lead Buyer Placing the Call or Text; headcount: One named seller per consent checkbox; focus: Hold the TrustedForm or Jornaya certificate before dialing. If you're a lead buyer the risk is on you (Seasalt AI).; spokes: role: Lead Capture Form; type: Consent capture; kpi: One checkbox per brand, 20-30px boxes, CTA text matched word for word. 1-3% conversion drop for a 10-20% contact-rate lift (LeadCaptureIO).; role: Certificate Record Field; type: Evidence retention; kpi: Hidden field labeled 'XX trusted form cert' exactly. Records kept at least 4 years (LeadCaptureIO).; role: Dialer and Text Automation; type: Regulated technology; kpi: Audit by capacity, not clicks. Preview dial likely an ATDS outside PA, DE and NJ. Text automation ends at day 90 on inquiry leads.; role: Revocation Desk; type: Opt-out handling; kpi: Honor within 10 business days, within 24 hours if practicable. Exposure of $500 to $2,000 per text or call violation.; caption: Each seller must be named and individually selected, and the caller holds the consent record before regulated technology touches the lead.; assumptions note: Practitioners disagree on status. Troutman treated the rule as live January 27, 2025, while LeadCaptureIO and Kyle Banks reported it shot down.; note: Sources - Lead Generation World (6VtW3u8e6WE @ 00:25:30, OgyCXKzIJM4 @ 00:24:16), Seasalt AI (KBFaRW7QmVQ), LeadCaptureIO (Hd19AToxex4, WXqAR94YqtU, Zrihem0vYcU), Lauro Herrera (tRO0J70WjKA @ 00:13:21).
